main_body: Grey metal mine cart body: a rim at the top, a dark tapering box below it, two wheels at the bottom corners, and a few gold ore nuggets above the rim.
top_band: none that reads as a surface: the only light row is a 1-row light grey rim (L=170, row 4) under the gold ore nuggets and a dark outline row. Below it the tones step straight down into the dark front body.
evidence: The one-pixel column scans (x=4, 8, 11) all show the same sequence: an outline row, one light rim row at row 4, then a graded dark ramp (L 126, 82, 61, 82) down to the bottom outline at rows 12-15. There is no multi-row lighter horizontal surface and no elliptical opening showing the inside of the cart. The ore nuggets sit above the rim as small props. This matches the guide's red 'rim only' and 'front elevation' cases, so the drawing fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours against 40 and 38 for the references, and 9 colours per tile against 17 and 20. About 92% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a grey-black line, not a dark tone of the adjacent material, which gives the sticker look. The grey ramp has a few steps, but the surfaces carry little grain or per-part variation next to the richly textured stall and well references. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, but that comes from the piece's small size and does not offset the shallow palette and neutral outline.
